tools.name: simulation.inject_failure
tools.description: Requires simulationId and resourceId from simulation.create. Injects a bounded resource failure; returns updated state. Next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.recover_resource and simulation.metrics to confirm authoritative health. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://g

tools.name: simulation.recover_resource
tools.description: Requires simulationId and resourceId from simulation.create. Requests reversible resource recovery; success does not prove healthy. Next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics to inspect resource health. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.r

tools.name: simulation.delete
tools.description: The likely next tool is simulation.create to use the freed slot. Prerequisite: a simulationId from simulation.create, or an active simulation in the preserved MCP session. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.delete

tools.name: scenario.list
tools.description: No prerequisites. Returns scenarios cards with id/name/summary. Filters precede stable ID paging: limit default 8, maximum 20; pass nextCursor as cursor until null. detailed=true restores rich cards per page. Next tool is scenario.get, then simulation.create with scenarioId. No API key required; dem

tools.name: scenario.get
tools.description: Requires scenarioId from scenario.list. Returns the complete selected graph, presets, assumptions and phase details. Next tool is simulation.create with scenarioId or the hydrated resources/connections. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/scenario.get

tools.name: simulation.create
tools.description: Create from scenarioId (scenario.list → scenario.get), or resources/connections for a custom graph. Returns id for simulation.step. Never blindly retry a timeout: creation may have succeeded. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.create

tools.name: simulation.step
tools.description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create (optional for the current demo simulation). Advances simulation; inspect completedSteps/currentStep, not HTTP success. Next tool is simulation.metrics. Preserve operationId and original inputs on retries. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resou

tools.name: simulation.metrics
tools.description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create (optional for current demo). Returns latest metrics or requested history; responseMode full retains evidence. Read authoritative resource health after recovery. No new identifiers. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/

tools.name: simulation.inject_traffic
tools.description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create and target traffic RPS. Returns applied traffic settings. Next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics to read observed latency; do not assume its direction. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.inj
